notes: Two branches joined by the taḥwil «ح»; the names from «ابن جريج» to «ثوبان» are written once after the last «ح» and form the shared tail
«إسماعيل، - يعني ابن إبراهيم -»: the editor's gloss is left out
«قال عثمان في حديثه مصدق» is a wording variant of one version: left out
«شيخا، من الحى» is unnamed; the Companion ثوبان ends the chain, the Prophet is not a link
